title: Words with weight
summary: Compare typographic judgment, material-specific movement, reading time and sound synchronization.
originNote: Original fictional task proposed for the requested cross-model animation comparison; this draft benchmark shape awaits owner acceptance.

setup.instructions: Verify fixtures/skill.tar.gz against fixtures/skill-lock.json, extract it and read skill/SKILL.md. Use the immutable source snapshot. Before Ready, pin and smoke the Node (22 or later), Python, browser, FFmpeg, fonts and skill-specific dependencies identically for every model. This draft is not cookable.

turns.content: Read fixtures/brief.md and the pinned skill. Create Words with weight using its workflow, and deliver the specified movie, live player, source, contact sheet and evidence. Make routine creative decisions yourself and iterate from rendered evidence.

checks.description: Check delivery files, unchanged player, PNG signature, H.264/AAC, 1080 by 1920, 60fps, 1440 frames, 24 seconds and evidence structure.

Is the exact copy readable at phone size for long enough? Do the four verbs have meaningfully different motion? Do stillness and the final hold create an intentional rhythm? Inspect actual playback, audio, authorship and correspondence between evidence times and visible events.
